title: JCB 930, 940, and 950 Critical Stop or Fault Code: Build the Service Packet First
summary: When a JCB 930, 940, or 950 rough-terrain forklift shows an illuminated critical stop warning or active fault code display, safe intake begins by recording the exact cluster indications and consulting the full Operator's Manual rather than attempting unguided repairs.
body_markdown:
## Official Document Boundaries and Disclaimers


The Quick Reference Guide explicitly states on page 1 that it does not replace the Operator's Manual and that operators must read all disclaimers, safety instructions, and other instructions in the Operator's Manual before initially operating the product.


The document provides no fault code lookup tables, troubleshooting trees, or repair procedures. JCB's official knowledge repository states that quick start guides provide basic machine and controls orientation, do not include health and safety aspects, and direct users to contact a JCB dealer for additional information.
